title: Mini UVM FIFO Environment Capstone
description: Build a complete FIFO UVM environment with an active agent, sequence, driver, monitor, scoreboard, coverage subscriber, and factory override.

steps.title: Step 1: Complete the Active Agent
steps.instructions: Fill in the transaction, sequence helpers, driver, monitor, sequencer, and active-agent construction in `testbench.sv`.

steps.title: Step 2: Wire Checking and Coverage
steps.instructions: Connect the monitor analysis port to the scoreboard FIFO and coverage subscriber, then implement queue-based compare logic and required coverage bins.

steps.title: Step 3: Exercise the Factory Override
steps.instructions: Override `fifo_base_seq` with `fifo_capstone_seq`, create the base type through the factory, and confirm the capstone sequence runs.

steps.title: Step 4: Prove the Bug and Closure
steps.instructions: Run once with `+define+INJECT_FIFO_BUG` to see a scoreboard mismatch, then run without the define to confirm zero mismatches and coverage closure.
